## Plan and test matrix

### Plan

1. Repair `docs/build/tools/obligation_events.py`: `migrate` refuses an
   existing log (creates a fresh one only); `--recorded-at` defaults to
   `date -u`; the write path rejects a `recorded_at`/`observed_at` later than
   today or later than the source commit's committer date; the chain check
   rejects a `recorded_at` earlier than the previous event's (effective)
   date — correction events excepted; a new `kind: "correction"` carries a
   `correction{…}` payload naming file, line, event_id, prior line sha256 and
   source commit, with `date-correction` reasons carrying
   field/recorded_value/true_value.
2. Extend `memory_guard.py` to admit and bind correction records (never a
   chain link; same-file corrections must chain `expected_previous_event` on
   the corrected event and name the right line).
3. `current_projection.py` / `closeout_protocol.py`: corrections never become
   the status head; assessments passed to the chain check so coverage
   corrections resolve.
4. Append the repair data through the tool's own fail-closed append path:
   97 `dc-recorded_at` + 84 `dc-observed_at` date corrections (incl. the
   L76/L82 specials), 4 coverage `dc-assessed_at`, 269 `rewrite-repair`
   corrections (89 @ b132bbbb, 90 @ 30d401dc, 90 @ 7a2ff9fa — every changed
   line cites the pre-rewrite line sha256 and its authoring commit), 8
   restored `e1` transitions chained on `e0`, and 5 queued transitions
   PT-001…PT-005 with their `applied` register rows and cell flips.
5. Append the MIGRATION.md correction block for L55–57 (ADR-146).
6. Verify: `check`, `activation-check`, `memory_guard all --worktree`,
   `make check`, prefix check vs the PR base, pending count 0.

### Test matrix (tests/unit/test_obligation_events.py)

| behaviour | test | failure mode covered |
|---|---|---|
| migrate refuses an existing log (bare + with transitions) | `test_migrate_refuses_existing_log` | wholesale regeneration |
| `recorded_at` defaults to `date -u` | `test_migrate_defaults_recorded_at_to_utc_clock` | fixed/argument dates |
| future `recorded_at` rejected (migrate + append) | `test_migrate_rejects_future_recorded_at`, `test_append_rejects_future_dates` | guessed schedule dates |
| `recorded_at` > source-commit date rejected | `test_append_rejects_recorded_at_later_than_source_commit` | evidence-postdating records |
| backwards `recorded_at` on a chain rejected | `test_chain_rejects_backwards_recorded_at` | retro-dating |
| correction validates, never moves the head, chains on the corrected event | `test_correction_events_validate_and_never_move_the_head` | annotation-as-link |
| correction target must exist | `test_correction_target_must_exist` | dangling correction |
| date-correction supersedes recorded value for monotonicity | `test_date_correction_supersedes_recorded_at_for_monotonicity` | wrong historical date blocking honest repair |
| existing suite (duplicates, missing predecessor, competing heads, cell divergence, coverage rules, verdict grammar) | unchanged, still green | regression |
